previousRule: The production mixed-order checkout accepts curtains, cushions and motorised tracks, while the Roman blind journey remains a local preview without an order path.
newRule: The existing Shopping Cart also accepts Roman blinds with server-side pricing, current stock checks, a complete Evans headrail kit, shared shipping, immutable draft-order snapshots and paid fabric-usage recording. Existing product gates and checkout paths remain in force.
reason: The owner asked for the Roman blinds journey to go live, for Add to Shopping Cart to save into Design My Home, and for Roman blinds to join a mixed order with curtains and other products. Protected regression tests cover cart persistence and paid-order reconciliation.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner explicitly authorised the live Roman blinds release and mixed-order path, then confirmed 4-5 calendar weeks after order confirmation for Roman dispatch. The protected GitHub policy still requires the owner's exact-head approval comment before this PR can merge.
